_comment: #1659 — the BYTES GET /api/telephony/sip-token really returns, pinned.
Generated by calling buildVolunteerSipParams (apps/worker/telephony/registrar.ts)
directly, with mintTurnCredentials at a fixed clock, so these are the server's own
output and not a transcription of it. Two cases: a host with TURN_HOST/TURN_SECRET
rendered, and a host without (#1657), which is every Ansible-deployed host before
this change.
Consumed by TWO suites, which is the point — neither can drift from the other or
from the contract, because the fixture is the only artefact between them:
apps/worker/__tests__/unit/sip-token-wire-body.test.ts  validates each payload
against sipTokenResponseSchema and asserts every key the Swift model REQUIRES is
a key the schema declares.
apps/ios/Tests/Unit/SipTokenResponseDecodingTests.swift  decodes the same bytes
through APIService's real decoder.
Same mechanism as apps/ios/Tests/Wire/ios-response-bodies.json (#1633/PR #1642),
extended in one way this endpoint needs: requiredSwiftKeys are DOTTED PATHS, because
this response is nested under `sip` and a flat key list cannot describe it.
Every value that could be mistaken for live key material is built from a FIXED byte
pattern through the registrar's own encoder, so it keeps the shape the decoder
cares about (length, charset, padding) and carries no entropy at all:
sip.username      volunteerSipUsername('ab'.repeat(32)) — vol_ + 16 hex chars.
iceServers[].credential  base64 of 20 zero bytes — an HMAC-SHA1 digest's length
and alphabet, which is all buildVolunteerSipParams and the Swift decoder read of
it. The HMAC itself is pinned on mintTurnCredentials in sip-registrar.test.ts,
where a byte-exact digest belongs; a wire fixture is the wrong artefact for it,
and a real one is 4.28 bits/char of base64 that no secret scanner can tell from a
live coturn credential (nor should be taught to — see sip-token-wire-body.test.ts,
which fails if one is reintroduced here).
The password and anchor are fabricated values of the right shape too. Nothing here is
a real credential, and nothing here is a real volunteer.
